summary: Ran live API and browser coverage for team access, owner auth, protected boundaries, status progression, OAuth initiation, and responsive layouts. Backend passed all 8 tests; frontend core login/PIN/OAuth flows work, but the required fixed team route and some owner navigation behavior are broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button is hidden at max-width 600px, so an authenticated mobile owner cannot sign out through the UI.
Browser console reports invalid HTML/hydration warning because a dynamically generated span is rendered inside option elements.

integration_issues.issue: Required /team/task-hub-1663 loads the inactive-link error; GET /api/team/task-hub-1663 returns 404. Seed creates random member slugs and no task-hub-1663 mapping.
affected_selectors: This team link is no longer active.

integration_issues.issue: All sidebar links change the URL, but AdminApp always renders AdminHome; /admin/finance, /admin/team, /admin/tasks, and /admin/audit show the overview instead of their feature content.

action_items: Map the required task-hub-1663 team route to the intended member/slug and seed stable data accordingly.
Implement actual admin route content for Team, All tasks, Finance, and Audit rather than always rendering AdminHome.
Keep logout accessible on mobile instead of hiding .side-bottom.
Render plain text inside member option elements to remove the invalid span/hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminApp ignores the nested route and always renders AdminHome, leaving the advertised owner management areas nonfunctional.
The random team slug generated at startup is incompatible with the required stable /team/task-hub-1663 contract.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_status_flow task during the status-transition regression test; no persistent seed data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public members/privacy, invalid and valid PINs, both owner credentials, auth/me/logout, admin boundaries, task status transitions, approval, protected redirect, OAuth redirect, and mobile overflow were tested. Recheck fixed team slug, admin subroutes, mobile logout, and picker console warning.
rca of the issue: The team seed uses name.lower()+random token for slug, while the requested stable task-hub-1663 route is never inserted or aliased. AdminApp computes an active nav label but has no nested route switch and always returns AdminHome. Mobile CSS sets .side-bottom{display:none}, removing logout. Dynamic option content is instrumented/rendered as a span under option, producing invalid DOM/hydration warnings.
